subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: For Telegram/source-channel turns that generate substantive final text but produce no outbound message, should OpenClaw keep the current documented message_tool_only privacy behavior, add default guarded recovery, or require an opt-in recovery mode?
rationale: Current main has diagnostics and partial Telegram identity/reaction fixes, but the remaining recovery behavior can change privacy and message-delivery semantics for existing source-channel users.

options.title: Keep open and choose one recovery policy
options.body: Use this issue and the linked recovery PRs to decide the final source-channel no-send behavior before closing the broader Telegram report.

options.title: Treat only message_tool_only as canonical
options.body: Move remaining recovery work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85714 and close this later only if a live current-main Telegram group repro shows no separate failure remains.

options.title: Document diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Accept current warning and docs behavior as intentional for tool-only mode, but require live proof that original Telegram group automatic replies are fixed before closing.

recommendation.title: Keep open and choose one recovery policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue and the linked recovery PRs to decide the final source-channel no-send behavior before closing the broader Telegram report.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics PR records this handle as the rewrite/product signal, and the remaining choice is a privacy and delivery-policy decision rather than a purely mechanical fix.
